en.headline: Police arrest 80-year-old man after community nurse reports indecent assault
en.dek: Yan Chai Hospital said a community nurse was allegedly assaulted during home visits on 31 July and 4 August; the hospital has zero tolerance for such behaviour and is supporting the staff member.
body: Yan Chai Hospital reported on Wednesday that a community nurse was allegedly indecently assaulted while conducting home visits on 31 July and 4 August. The hospital notified police after receiving the nurse’s report.

Police later arrested an 80-year-old man in connection with the alleged incidents. The hospital said it takes a zero-tolerance approach to any alleged indecent assault against its staff and is cooperating fully with the investigation.

The hospital has offered support and consolation to the nurse concerned and has reported the matter to the Hospital Authority head office through the early incident notification system. Further details of the case have not been released by police.

zh.headline: 仁濟社康護士外出探訪疑被非禮 警拘80歲男子
zh.dek: 院方指一名社康護士於7月31日及8月4日探訪期間懷疑被非禮，接報後報警，警方其後拘捕一名80歲男子。
body: 仁濟醫院周三表示，一名社康護士於7月31日及8月4日外出探訪病人期間，懷疑被非禮。院方接獲該名護士報告後，隨即報警。
警方其後拘捕一名80歲男子。院方強調高度關注事件，對涉嫌非禮員工的行為採取「零容忍」態度，並會嚴肅跟進及全力配合警方調查。
院方已向該名社康護士致以慰問及提供支援，並已透過早期事故通報系統向醫院管理局總辦事處呈報事件。警方暫未公布更多案情。
